method: Sequential Release native captures, frozen extraction and VSync off. Matched paired Sweep runs use 32 warmups/128 timed samples, admissions included. Full quality/appearance/traversal matrix uses eight exact readbacks. No live simulation throughput claim.
limitations: Initial failed CPU cohort retained; renewed matched and paired gates pass after deferred control uploads and per-frame event pumping.
Four renewed matched final pixel hashes and draw counts equal master.
Rapid traversal retains first-use material/admission costs, CPU p99 up to 95.3441 ms and allocation p99 up to 25507112 bytes.
The 1000-object fixture contains no vegetation; plant density is measured separately on IndustrialBase, and vehicle invariance is checked on the 1000-object fixture.
No sustained 60 FPS, manual art golden, physical-monitor acceptance, long resize soak or real device-removal qualification.

comparison.interpretation: Percent changes are observed variance/trends. Paired runs and repeated cohorts are required before attributing a regression. GPU subsets have explicit counts; software and changed settings cannot satisfy a hardware gate.

initialComparison.interpretation: Percent changes are observed variance/trends. Paired runs and repeated cohorts are required before attributing a regression. GPU subsets have explicit counts; software and changed settings cannot satisfy a hardware gate.

cleanPackage.note: Development package, no merge or release. Normal smoke uses existing development stress primitives; reference capture uses production assets with zero fallback meshes.
